source_collection.missing_day_rule: A missing or ineligible calendar day makes its named cohort incomplete; it is recorded as a frame failure when the daily lane reaches it and is never silently excluded or replaced.
source_collection.regime_rule: Dictionary, production matcher and canonical matcher-specification hashes must remain identical across both cohorts.

sampling.primary_unit: completed score day, channel, query group, production document key
sampling.probability_design: Within each channel, sort every eligible contribution by SHA-256 of the frozen seed, channel and frame id; take the first 500 without replacement, or census the channel if N is below 500.
sampling.multiplicity: A document that contributes to two production query groups enters the population twice. The contribution instances remain separate in the primary sample.
sampling.coder_order: The same audit ids are independently SHA-256-ranked into two coder-specific orders.
sampling.external_freeze_receipt: The rights-safe package/frame/sample/sheet hash receipt must be publicly committed before either coder receives any package file.

coding.primary_independence: No role in IGRM design, dictionaries, rubric, sampling, assistant, website or prior labels; all relationships and recruitment sources disclosed.
coding.payment: Fixed before coding and independent of agreement, ON share, pass/fail, publication or publicity.
coding.adjudication: A distinct masked third reviewer may examine disagreements after both primary sheets are hash-locked. Adjudication is secondary and cannot replace either coder-specific primary.
coding.coder_attestation: Each primary coder returns a private hash-bound process declaration with a distinct opaque coder id, Git-anchored freeze receipt, ordered access/completion times, independence, outcome-independent compensation, pilot-first ordering, no collaboration, no LLM/classifier labelling and no viewing of IGRM outputs or prior labels during scoring.

estimands.primary: For each coder and channel separately, ON divided by ON plus OFF among the sampled group-qualified contribution instances in the named cohort.
estimands.firm_label_interval: Wilson 95 percent interval, descriptive because ABSTAIN is non-random missingness.
estimands.missingness_robust_interval: Exact finite-population 95 percent interval with every ABSTAIN counted as OFF.
estimands.inter_coder: Raw agreement and binary Gwet AC1 on unique evidence identities with firm labels from both coders.

quality_gates.per_coder_channel: At least 400 firm labels; firm-label Wilson 95 percent lower bound at least 0.80; and exact finite-population 95 percent lower bound at least 0.80 when every ABSTAIN is OFF.
quality_gates.per_channel_reliability: At least 400 unique-evidence firm overlaps, non-constant pooled labels, zero within-coder repeat conflicts, raw agreement at least 0.90 and Gwet AC1 at least 0.70.
quality_gates.overall: All ten coder-channel precision gates and all five channel reliability gates pass conjunctively.
quality_gates.publication: Every channel, abstention, access failure, disagreement, repeat conflict, deviation and failed or inconclusive gate publishes regardless of direction.

rights_and_release.private_packet: Coder packets may contain third-party titles and URLs for private external-audit use; this registration grants no redistribution or relicensing right.
rights_and_release.public_result: A separate source-by-source rights review decides whether public rows contain title, URL, domain/date only, or hashes only.
rights_and_release.verification: The public result binds to the private package and returned coder files by SHA-256 without making restricted evidence public.
